messages:
sophia_marketing: ArcadiaAI case study check-in  we have the interview recording and signed release. Need final quote confirmation + legal OK by Tue EOD to publish next Thu.

matt_seo: I'll draft 3 SEO headlines tonight. Any embargo or distribution limits?

rachel_cs: Customer asked to exclude cloud vendor names and to avoid ARR/contract length. They approved a pull quote attributed to 'T. Huang, Head of ML' and signed the release.

noah_pm: Benchmarks: steady-state throughput ~3.1x, p95 latency dropped from ~460ms to ~170ms on their 1k-token profile. I'll prepare a brief methods note.

zoe_design: I'll build a hero banner and a stat card. Which logo variant did they pick?

sophia_marketing: Use the horizontal mark. Also they want the quote wording exactly as in the signed PDF.

legal_bot: Confirmed: redact hostnames, S3 paths, and contract IDs. Distribution: NA/EU only per customer. Must include signed PDF in PR.

matt_seo: Draft headlines: 1) "ArcadiaAI scales predictable inference with Redwood" 2) "How ArcadiaAI cut p95 latency by ~63%" 3) "ArcadiaAI achieves over 3x throughput on Redwood" Thoughts?

rachel_cs: Customer asked to soften throughput to "over three times the throughput" and approved the latency numbers. They want publish Thu 9am PT. Signed release uploaded.

infra_ops: Sanitized artifacts will go to s3://redwood-marketing/arcadiaai/sanitized/2026-04-20/. I'll run the redaction scan before PR merge.

zoe_design: Uploaded draft assets to design/marketing/arcadiaai-case-v0.2.zip. Left space for the exact pull quote.

sophia_marketing: I'll open the PR now, tag reviewers. Internal review deadline Tue 3pm PT, publish Thu 9am PT. Thanks team :tada:
